name: Astra for OpenClaw
description: Complete development lifecycle workflow — spec, design, plan, architect, implement, review — with multi-model orchestration and deterministic stage-gate checks.

models.description: Model assignment per agent role. Each agent can use the best model for its task.

pm.description: Product manager — structured analysis, requirement writing

designer.description: UI/UX designer — component specs, design tokens

planner.description: Implementation planner — codebase analysis, phased planning

architect.description: Technical architect — API design, data models, ADRs

coder.description: Code implementation — delegates to Aider for edits

reviewer.description: Code reviewer — security, correctness, spec compliance

debugger.description: Debugger — deep reasoning for root cause analysis

telegramChatId.description: Telegram chat/group ID to send notifications to

aider.description: Aider configuration for the coder agent.

enabled.description: Use Aider for code implementation (false = agent codes directly)

model.description: Model for Aider to use (overrides models.coder when Aider is enabled)

extraArgs.description: Additional CLI arguments to pass to Aider

graphify.description: Knowledge graph configuration for codebase context.

enabled.description: Use graphify for codebase context (false = agents scan manually)

updateInterval.description: How often to rebuild the graph (cron interval)

scope.description: Directory to scan (default: project root, use 'src/' for large repos)

buildMarathon.description: Main pipeline heartbeat — check progress, advance phases

continuousBuild.description: Lighter check — verify nothing is stalled
